script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: REDO

FADE IN:

INT. APT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

30s, JESSICA, sits cross-legged on the floor, eyes glued to the TV screen.

TV: (NEWS) ...a new, innovative program, called "Redo," has recently launched. This program grants individuals a second chance to relive the critical moments of their lives...

Jessica sighs, staring at the screen in awe. She has lived with regret for years.

INT. JESSICA'S BEDROOM - MORNING

Jessica wakes up to the sound of her alarm clock. She stands up and approaches the window, looking out at the rain.

Jessica: (murmurs) Another day.

As she walks to the bathroom, she remembers a conversation she had with her friend, Emily, a few nights ago.

INT. EMILY'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Emily: (excitedly) "Jessica, have you heard about 'Redo'? It's amazing! I mean, a second chance to fix our mistakes..."

Jessica: (sighs) "Emily, I've made too many mistakes. I don't deserve a second chance."

INT. JESSICA'S BEDROOM - MORNING

Jessica finishes her morning routine and reaches for her phone. She hesitates, then dials the Redo hotline.

JESSICA: (nervously) "Hello, I'd like to apply for the Redo program."

---

INT. REDO HEADQUARTERS - DAY

A young man, LUCAS, a Redo counselor, greets Jessica at the reception desk.

LUCAS: (smiling) "Welcome to Redo, Ms. Jessica. I'm Lucas. I'll be guiding you through the process."

INT. REDO CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Jessica sits at a table with five other participants, all sharing their stories of regret.

Participant 1: (tearfully) "I wish I could go back and tell my mother I loved her before she died."

Participant 2: (frustrated) "I'd relive high school and do things differently. I'd be successful now."

Jessica looks around the room, realizing she's not alone in her regrets.

INT. REDO LAB - DAY

Jessica undergoes a series of tests, including a memory scan and a psychological evaluation.

INT. REDO CHAMBER - NIGHT

Jessica is enclosed in a transparent chamber, and as she closes her eyes, she feels a strange sensation. She is transported back to her past.

---

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Jessica, a teenager, stands nervously at the edge of the gymnasium, watching her classmates prepare for a volleyball game.

Classmate: (sneering) "Why aren't you playing, Jessica? Afraid you'll mess up again?"

Jessica: (timidly) "I just don't think I'm good enough."

Older Jessica, watching from the present, clenches her fists in determination.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Jessica sits across from her former boyfriend, MIKE, who is now engaged to another woman.

Mike: (smirking) "So, you didn't even try to stop me from leaving. I guess you didn't care enough."

Jessica: (heartbroken) "I loved you. I still do."

Older Jessica clutches her heart, wishing she could have done things differently.

---

INT. REDO CHAMBER - NIGHT (REDO)

Jessica finds herself back in her high school gymnasium. This time, she steps forward to join her teammates.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY (REDO)

Older Jessica approaches Mike, who is now sitting alone, looking sad. She confesses her love for him and apologizes for her past mistakes.

MIKE: (surprised) "Jessica? I had no idea you felt this way."

Jessica: (hopeful) "Can we try again? I'm not the same person I was back then."

Mike hesitates, then nods, offering her a second chance.

INT. JESSICA'S BEDROOM - MORNING

Jessica wakes up, feeling refreshed. She walks to the window and looks out at the rain, a smile on her face.

Jessica: (whispers) "I have a second chance."

---

INT. REDO HEADQUARTERS - DAY

Lucas, the Redo counselor, greets Jessica warmly.

LUCAS: "Congratulations, Jessica. You've successfully completed the Redo program. I believe you're ready for your second chance."

Jessica nods, ready to face her past and make amends.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYM - DAY

Jessica, now a confident and skilled volleyball player, leads her team to victory.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica and Mike, now a couple, sit together, enjoying their coffee and each other's company.

---

INT. REDO HEADQUARTERS - DAY

Jessica stands at the reception desk, now a Redo counselor herself.

First-time Participant: (anxiously) "I don't know if I can do this. I've made too many mistakes."

Jessica: (smiling) "We all have. But it's never too late for a second chance. Trust me, I know."

Jessica leads the participant to the conference room, ready to guide them through the process.

FADE OUT.
